messages:
Elena: deploy-bot put staging promo on HOLD. artifact fetch failing with tarball checksum mismatch on blob-9, some integration tests timed out. change window ends in 50m.

deploy-bot: PROMO_HOLD staging canary v2026.7.14 -> v2026.7.15
checks: artifact-fetch: FAILED (tarball checksum mismatch x2, 404 on blob-9 x1)
integration: 6/9 passed (auth.integration.js timeout x2, billing.integration.js mismatch x1)
logs: https://ci.internal/4412500000/build/7

Marcus: checksum mismatch + 404 smells like CI cache eviction or partial upload. ops-bot, any S3/registry noise?

ops-bot: INFRA_ALERT: registry reported elevated 5xx and multipart finalize retries in us-east-1 between 03:05-03:12 UTC. Cache-pruner ran at 03:10 UTC and removed 15 keys.

Elena: product expects cut. options: 1) pin to v2026.7.14 to keep window; 2) rebuild artifacts and rerun canary (may miss window); 3) delay. thoughts?

Marcus: pin is fastest. we can force rebuild + reupload after infra stabilizes and verify in a smoke run. pin minimizes customer impact.

Elena: any risk shipping without new patch? the billing integration mismatch might be unrelated but we should call it out in release notes.

Marcus: agree. we'll add a note: "Pinned previous image due to transient artifact fetch failures; will re-run canary and reintroduce changes after infra verification." Add contact and ETA.

Elena: ok. Marcus, open promo-pin PR and I'll prepare release note. Also open infra ticket to investigate cache-pruner timing and registry 5xx.

Marcus: PR created https://git.internal/repo/promo-pin/202. Infra ticket https://infra.internal/tickets/1721. Draft release note: "Pinned canary to v2026.7.14 due to transient artifact fetch failures causing checksum mismatches; features in v2026.7.15 will be revalidated and rolled forward in next patch. Contact: @Elena."

deploy-bot: ACTION: promo pinned to v2026.7.14 (manual override) by Marcus at 4412500125. Release window preserved.

ci-bot: CI follow-up: queueing artifact rebuild and smoke canary once infra ticket resolved.

Elena: thanks. follow-ups: Marcus to manual promote, ops to triage S3/registry and cache-pruner, QA to run smoke after rebuild. closing thread.
